title: Creamy Pasta Bake
description: A rich and comforting pasta dish, perfect for a cold evening. This creamy bake combines the flavors of parmesan cheese with a hint of portuguese flair.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a pan, heat oil over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in parmesan and portuguese cheese until melted.
Combine cooked pasta and cheese mixture. Season with salt and pepper.
Transfer pasta mixture to a baking dish.
Bake in preheated oven for 15-20 minutes or until top is golden brown.
